import json, os, sys, math, statistics, textwrap, platform
path="/mnt/data/76c4f6760f4fe71cd67c616641354408-data.json"
with open(path,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data=json.load(f)
type(data), data.keys()
import pprint, json
pprint.pp(data, width=120, sort_dicts=False)
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib import font_manager
from matplotlib.transforms import Bbox
import numpy as np, os, json, math, platform, textwrap

# Select a font that covers all supplied characters (there are no CJK glyphs here, but verify all characters).
all_text = []
all_text.extend([data["labels"][k] for k in ("title","x_label","y_label","caption")])
pres = data["presentation"]
all_text.extend([pres["axes"]["x"]["label"], pres["axes"]["x"]["unit"],
                 pres["axes"]["y"]["label"], pres["axes"]["y"]["unit"],
                 pres["legend"]["title"]])
for e in pres["legend"]["entries"]:
    all_text.append(e.get("label",""))
for a in pres["abbreviations"]:
    all_text.extend([a["term"], a["definition"]])
all_text.extend(pres["statistical_notes"])

chars = sorted(set("".join(all_text)))
font_candidates = ["DejaVu Sans", "Liberation Sans", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Arial Unicode MS"]
chosen_font = None
font_path = None
for name in font_candidates:
    try:
        p = font_manager.findfont(name, fallback_to_default=False)
    except Exception:
        continue
    ft = matplotlib.ft2font.FT2Font(p)
    cmap = ft.get_charmap()
    if all(ord(c) in cmap or c in "\n\r\t" for c in chars):
        chosen_font = name
        font_path = p
        break
chosen_font, font_path, [c for c in chars if ord(c)>127][:20]
# Compute statistics independently
obs = data["observations"]
rules = data["plot_config"]["rules"]
assert data["figure_kind"] == "line"
assert rules["x_type"] == "numeric"
assert rules["aggregation"] == "unique"

# Ungrouped because grouped is false; missing group is accepted as the single ungrouped series.
valid_rows = [r for r in obs if r.get("x") is not None]
# detect duplicate numeric x
xs = [float(r["x"]) for r in valid_rows]
if len(set(xs)) != len(xs):
    raise ValueError("Duplicate X under unique aggregation")
points=[]
for r in sorted(valid_rows, key=lambda r: float(r["x"])):
    y=r.get("y")
    points.append({
        "x": float(r["x"]),
        "y": None if y is None else float(y),
        "n": 0 if y is None else 1,
        "missing": 1 if y is None else 0
    })
statistics={"series":[{"group": None, "points": points}]}

result = {
    "schema_version": data["schema_version"],
    "figure_kind": data["figure_kind"],
    "language": data["language"],
    "plot_config": data["plot_config"],
    "title": data["labels"]["title"],
    "x_label": data["labels"]["x_label"],
    "y_label": data["labels"]["y_label"],
    "caption": data["labels"]["caption"],
    "presentation": data["presentation"],
    "statistics": statistics,
    "environment": {
        "python_version": platform.python_version(),
        "matplotlib_version": matplotlib.__version__,
        "font": chosen_font
    }
}
out_json="/mnt/data/result.json"
with open(out_json,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(result,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)[:2000])
from PIL import Image

style=data["plot_config"]["style"]
W,H,DPI=style["width"],style["height"],300
fs=style["font_size"]

matplotlib.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": chosen_font,
    "font.size": fs,
    "axes.titlesize": fs,
    "axes.labelsize": fs,
    "xtick.labelsize": fs,
    "ytick.labelsize": fs,
    "legend.fontsize": fs,
    "figure.facecolor": "white",
    "axes.facecolor": "white",
    "savefig.facecolor": "white",
    "text.parse_math": False,
})

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(W/DPI,H/DPI), dpi=DPI, facecolor="white")
# Dedicated regions: title 0.93-0.99, plot 0.32-0.89, caption/abbr below.
ax=fig.add_axes([0.105,0.335,0.86,0.54])

x=np.array([p["x"] for p in points], dtype=float)
y=np.array([np.nan if p["y"] is None else p["y"] for p in points], dtype=float)
line_color="#0173B2"  # colorblind palette
ax.plot(x,y,color=line_color,linewidth=2.2,marker="o",markersize=6.5,
        markerfacecolor=line_color,markeredgecolor="white",markeredgewidth=0.8,
        solid_capstyle="round", zorder=3)

ax.set_xlim(0.8,5.2)
ax.set_ylim(0,22)
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_yticks([0,5,10,15,20])
ax.set_xlabel(pres["axes"]["x"]["label"] if not pres["axes"]["x"]["unit"] else f'{pres["axes"]["x"]["label"]} ({pres["axes"]["x"]["unit"]})',
              labelpad=10)
ax.set_ylabel(pres["axes"]["y"]["label"] if not pres["axes"]["y"]["unit"] else f'{pres["axes"]["y"]["label"]} ({pres["axes"]["y"]["unit"]})',
              labelpad=12)
ax.grid(axis="y",color="#D9D9D9",linewidth=0.8)
ax.grid(axis="x",visible=False)
ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["left"].set_color("#444444")
ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#444444")
ax.tick_params(colors="#333333", length=4)

title_obj=fig.text(0.535,0.955,data["labels"]["title"],ha="center",va="center",
                   fontsize=fs,fontweight="bold",color="#111111")

caption_obj=fig.text(0.06,0.205,data["labels"]["caption"],ha="left",va="top",
                     fontsize=fs,color="#222222",wrap=True,linespacing=1.25)

abbr_text = "Abbreviations: " + "; ".join(f'{a["term"]} = {a["definition"]}' for a in pres["abbreviations"])
abbr_obj=fig.text(0.06,0.062,abbr_text,ha="left",va="bottom",
                  fontsize=fs,color="#333333",wrap=True,linespacing=1.2)

# draw and inspect
fig.canvas.draw()
renderer=fig.canvas.get_renderer()
objs={"title":title_obj,"caption":caption_obj,"abbr":abbr_obj,
      "xlabel":ax.xaxis.label,"ylabel":ax.yaxis.label}
bboxes={k:o.get_window_extent(renderer=renderer) for k,o in objs.items()}
{k:(round(v.x0,1),round(v.y0,1),round(v.x1,1),round(v.y1,1)) for k,v in bboxes.items()}
# Reposition data axes and explanatory text to remove overlap.
ax.set_position([0.105,0.42,0.86,0.455])
caption_obj.set_position((0.06,0.29))
abbr_obj.set_position((0.06,0.018))
fig.canvas.draw()
renderer=fig.canvas.get_renderer()
bboxes={k:o.get_window_extent(renderer=renderer) for k,o in objs.items()}
{k:(round(v.x0,1),round(v.y0,1),round(v.x1,1),round(v.y1,1)) for k,v in bboxes.items()}
out_png="/mnt/data/figure.png"
fig.savefig(out_png,dpi=DPI,facecolor="white",edgecolor="white",bbox_inches=None,pad_inches=0)
plt.close(fig)

im=Image.open(out_png)
im.size, im.mode, os.path.getsize(out_png), os.path.getsize(out_json)
